name: Public Registry
checked_how: Read-only GET of each URL. Edit this file by hand when a status changes; the site build makes no network calls.

checks.title: Check a file
checks.what: Choose a file and the page hashes it in your browser, then looks the fingerprint up in the registry's anchored files. Only the fingerprint is sent.

checks.title: Look up a record by its fingerprint
checks.what: Enter an anchored record's fingerprint to see the record, its transaction and any corrections.

checks.title: Licensed-merchant certificates
checks.status_label: Live, no Modular City certificates yet
checks.what: What a BRC-52 licensed-merchant certificate says, and how to check one. Modular City certificates wait for the registry's permanent signing keys.

checks.title: Event stream
checks.what: Every registry action in order, with no gaps, as JSON.

checks.title: Anchoring fee treasury
checks.what: Deposits and the fee spent on each anchor, as JSON.

checks.title: A day's fingerprint
checks.what: One Merkle root over every record anchored that UTC day, with its leaves in order.

checks.title: One record's place in its day
checks.what: The inclusion proof linking one anchor to its day's root, in the same shape as the example on this page.
